newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Captall buys financial planner Fincorp.
newsitem.headline: Captall buys financial planner Fincorp.

text.p: Capital Alliance Holdings said on Thursday it had acquired the entire business operations of Financial Services Corp (Pty) Ltd (Fincorp), a provider of macro financial planning services to individuals and corporates.
Captall gave no price for the deal, which is effective retrospectively from April 1, 1997.
Chief executive Mark Barnes said on Wednesday that the reasoning behind the acquisition, which forms part of the group's strategy to expand, was to develop its personal finance advice business.

The bank aims to broaden its relationship interface to develop a fully-fledged merchant bank within 18 months and plans to be one of South Africa's top five financial services groups within seven to 10 years.

"We aim to be one of the top five financial services groups in South Africa within the next seven to 10 years. But, frankly, I'll be surprised if it takes us that long," Barnes told an investment analysts presentation.
"We want to build a broadly-based, truly South African financial services group, creating shareholder wealth through sustained earnings growth and capital investment," he said.
